title: Shukr wheel
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y3 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: shukr wheel)
intro: Lesson 11: Shukr: saying alhamdulillah. To understand what shukr (gratitude) is and how Muslims thank Allah with words, hearts and actions

questions.q: Give three ways to show shukr.
questions.a: Say alhamdulillah, feel thankful in the heart, use blessings well
questions.model: Teacher: 'Tongue: I say alhamdulillah. Heart: I feel thankful. Actions: I use my hands to help.'

questions.a: All praise and thanks are for Allah
options: All praise and thanks are for Allah

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, complete the shukr wheel: for tongue, heart and actions, write one way you will show thanks this week.
questions.a: Three ways, one for each part
questions.model: Teacher fills 'tongue': 'I will say alhamdulillah after every meal.'

questions.q: say the du'a after eating if you know it.
questions.a: Alhamdulillah (or a longer du'a the class has learnt)

questions.q: what does Allah promise the grateful in 14:7?
Back to our ponder: what will you thank Allah for tomorrow morning?
questions.a: Pupils' own, for example waking up healthy
